verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly state that Phoenix accepts traces over the OpenTelemetry protocol (OTLP), is built on OpenTelemetry, and uses OpenInference instrumentation that is not tied to any vendor or framework. Apps can send OTLP traces through auto-instrumentation or manual tracing decorators, and Phoenix receives and displays them, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: OTLP transport and endpoint details (gRPC vs HTTP, ports, collector setup), evidence of re-exporting stored traces out via OTLP, and independent hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion specifically.
